contract: Road user a moves across the designated direction of travel of carrier region r: a is moving, its speed (kin.speed) above speed_tol, and its velocity (kin.velocity) makes with r's designated direction (st.lane_direction) an angle whose cosine, in absolute value, is at most cos_max: the absolute value of the dot product of the velocity with the normalised direction is at most cos_max times the speed. Either sense of crossing is denoted: the sign of the direction does not matter. It is a state at one observation: it says nothing of whether a occupies r, of where a began or will end its movement, or of how long it has moved so. Not denoted: a road user at rest or moving at or below speed_tol; a road user moving more nearly along r's direction than cos_max allows. Where r carries no designated direction, or a's velocity is not observed, it is unknown.

params.name: speed_tol
params.meaning: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement

params.name: cos_max
params.meaning: the largest absolute cosine between the velocity and the carrier's designated direction at which the motion counts as across the carrier

elements.justification: kin.speed: 'magnitude of velocity' (m/s); above speed_tol the road user is moving.
kin.velocity: 'velocity vector' (m/s, world frame); its dot product with the direction gives the motion along the carrier.
st.lane_direction: 'direction of travel designated for a structure a vehicle travels in — a lane, ... or a roadway', read normalised; a place no carrier covers has none (unknown).

scenarios.name: holds
scenarios.narrative: A pedestrian on a lane whose direction is east walks north at 1.4 m/s: the dot product is zero, at most cos_max times the speed.

scenarios.name: fails
scenarios.narrative: A pedestrian on the same lane walks east along it at 1.4 m/s: the absolute cosine is 1, above cos_max.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: A pedestrian on the lane moves, but its velocity is not observed.
